name: Secrets of the Royals: Births, Marriages and Deaths
original_name: Secrets of the Royals: Births, Marriages and Deaths
overview: Royal Births, Marriages, and Death is a captivating new ten-part documentary series featuring a dynamic and fresh cast of contributors with specialist expertise, extraordinary archive, ancient documents that reveal incredible insight. This stunning new series tells the story of a thousand years of monarchy through these powerful and pivotal moments.
